Required cargo-build + source-lint gate over the rewritten fuzz body. Critical patch noted: contract C-7 originally said `cargo build -p fuzz --bin recovery_decode`, but fuzz/Cargo.toml:2 declares package name `velvet-ballistics-fuzz` (not `fuzz`); the corrected command `cargo build --bin recovery_decode --manifest-path fuzz/Cargo.toml` runs against the correct workspace and is reflected in the planned obligation. Verified fuzz/Cargo.toml contains a [[bin]] recovery_decode entry and fuzz/src/bin/recovery_decode.rs re-exports the harness via `run_with_stdin(fuzz_lib::fuzz_recovery_decode)`. The compound command chains `cargo build` (compile gate) with six inverted `rg` invocations covering C-8 forbidden patterns: `assert!(...||...)`, `matches!(*, ..)` over run_summary, `let _summary`, `dbg!` over run_summary, `.unwrap()`, and `.expect(`. Scope is correctly restricted to fuzz/src/journal_target/readback.rs (so legitimate uses elsewhere are not flagged). The pre-fix harness uses `unwrap_or(0)` (line 185) which does not match `\.unwrap\(\)`; the rg gate is precise.
